triggers.name: new_email
triggers.title: New email
triggers.help: Checks for new emails every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes. Supports email attachment of up to 25mb.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up trigger events from this specified date and time. Defaults to one day from time of start of recipe. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cann…

input.name: label_ids
input.label: Label
input.hint: Fetch only emails with selected labels. All emails will be fetched if left blank. Learn more

input.name: includeSpamTrash
input.label: Include spam and trash
input.hint: Include emails from spam and trash in the results. Defaults to No if left blank.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Gmail action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Gmail connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_draft
actions.title: Create draft
actions.help: Create a draft email that can be reviewed and sent later. The draft will be saved in the connected user's Drafts folder.

input.name: to
input.label: To
input.hint: Provide the recipient email address(es) separated by comma.

input.name: email_type
input.label: Email type
input.hint: Select the format of the email message

input.name: body
input.label: Message
input.hint: Plain text if selected email type is Text , HTML formatted if selected email type is HTML

input.name: from
input.label: From
input.hint: Provide alias email ID or name. Leave blank to use the connected account.

input.name: cc
input.label: Cc
input.hint: Provide the email address(es) to send carbon copy (cc) separated by comma.

input.name: bcc
input.label: Bcc
input.hint: Provide the email address(es) to send blind carbon copy (bcc) separated by comma.

input.name: reply_to
input.label: Reply to
input.hint: Provide the email address to reply to

input.name: thread_id
input.label: Thread ID
input.hint: Thread ID to associate this draft with an existing conversation

input.name: in_reply_to
input.label: In-Reply-To
input.hint: Message-ID of the email being replied to

input.name: references
input.label: References
input.hint: References header for threading

actions.name: download_attachment
actions.title: Download attachment
actions.help: Retrieve the content of a specific attachment of an email. This content can be used to upload the attachment into another app in subsequent recipe steps.

input.name: id
input.label: Email ID
input.hint: ID of email containing attachment. Obtain from the New email trigger.

input.name: attachmentId
input.label: Attachment ID
input.hint: ID of attachment to download. Obtain from the New email trigger.

actions.name: get_email_or_draft_by_id
actions.title: Get email or draft by ID
actions.description: Get email or draft by ID in Gmail
actions.help: Get details and content of a specific email or draft from Gmail by providing its ID.

input.name: message_type
input.label: Message type
input.hint: Select whether to fetch an email or a draft

input.name: id
input.label: ID
input.hint: ID of the email or draft to fetch

actions.name: send_draft
actions.title: Send draft
actions.help: Send a previously created draft email. Provide the draft ID obtained from the Create draft action.

input.name: draftId
input.label: Draft ID
input.hint: The ID of the draft to send. Obtain from the Create draft action.
